'''Ashot Chilingarian''' ({{langx|hy|Աշոտ Չիլինգարյան}}; born 18 May 1949) is an Armenian physicist known for his contributions to the fields of [[High-energy astronomy|high-energy astrophysics]], [[space weather]], and [[atmospheric physics|high-energy atmospheric physics]]. He is the head of the [[Cosmic ray|Cosmic Ray]] Division (CRD) and the director of the [[Yerevan Physics Institute|Alikhanyan Physics Institute]] in Armenia.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.aragats.am/Cosmic_Ray_Division_Head_And_Programs_Director |title=YerPhI And Programs Director&nbsp;— Cosmic Ray Division |publisher=Aragats.am |date= |access-date=2013-10-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://ihy.boulder.swri.edu/people/chili.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131101065607/http://ihy.boulder.swri.edu/people/chili.shtml |url-status=dead |archive-date=2013-11-01 |title=IHY&nbsp;— People |publisher=Ihy.boulder.swri.edu |date= |access-date=2013-10-29 }}</ref><ref>Yerevan Physics Institute. [http://www.yerphi.am/admin.htm Administration] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131103230858/http://www.yerphi.am/admin.htm |date=2013-11-03 }}. Retrieved 2 November 2013.</ref>

== Life and career ==
Chilingarian was born on 18 May 1949, in [[Yerevan]], Armenia into an academic family. His father, Aghasi Chilingarian, was a biologist and the head of the Institute of Zoology of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Armenia]], mother Nora Nazarbekova graduated from Saint Petersburg Chemistry-Technological Institute. His elder sister, Marina Chilingarian graduated from the [[Armenian State Pedagogical University]]. {{citation needed|date=October 2013}}

He entered the Faculty of Physics of [[Yerevan State University]] in 1966, and in 1971 received his bachelor's degree in [[nuclear physics]]. He earned his PhD degree in 1984 and Doctorate of Science in Physics and Mathematics in 1991 from the [[Yerevan Physics Institute]] (YerPhi).

As a professor, Chilingarian has significantly contributed to high-energy astrophysics, cosmic rays, and
[[atmospheric physics]]. These include measuring the "knee" in the energy spectrum of light and heavy cosmic ray nuclei at Aragats between 1998 and 2003, determining the maximum energy of solar proton
accelerators in 2005, and developing Neural Network and Bayesian statistical models for gamma ray
image purification and galactic nuclei classification. He also created the ANI package for statistical
analysis, which has been implemented in various experiments such as WIPPLE, MAGIC, KASCASE,
and ANI.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Alikhanyan |first1=A.I. |title=National Science Laboratory |url=https://www.aanl.am/?p=47&pni=20&lang=en |website="A. I. Alikhanyan national science laboratory (Yerevan Physics Institute)" foundation |publisher="A. I. Alikhanyan national science laboratory (Yerevan Physics Institute)" foundation |access-date=28 June 2023}}</ref>

== Awards ==
During his professional life, Chilingarian has received many awards including:
*Winner of the first ever World Summit on Information Society award in e-Science for the Data Visualization Interactive Network project in 2003<ref>{{cite news |author=AZG Daily |url=http://www.azg.am/EN/2003112204 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20131030100450/http://www.azg.am/EN/2003112204 |url-status=dead |archive-date=October 30, 2013 |title=ARMENIA'S COSMIC RAY DIVISION GETS WORLD SUMMIT AWARD |publisher=Azg.am |date=2003-11-22 |access-date=2013-10-29 }}</ref>
*In 2008, Yerevan, Contribution to science by Armenia
*Presidential Award in the field of physics for a series of research papers referred to as "High-energy phenomena in thunderous atmosphere" in 2012<ref>{{cite web|url=http://panorama.am/en/analytics/2013/05/30/presidential-award-ceremony/ |title=2012 Presidential Award Ceremony completed&nbsp;— Analysis&nbsp;— Panorama &#124; Armenian news |publisher=Panorama.am |date=2013-05-30 |access-date=2013-10-31}}</ref>

== Affiliations ==
Chilingarian is a member of many professional societies such as:

* Armenia's representative to the [[Committee on Space Research|International Commission for Space Research]] (COSPAR)
* Armenia's representative to the International Space Weather Initiative (ISWI)
* Armenia's representative to the European COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology) action ES0803: "Developing space weather products and services in Europe"
* Founder and spokesperson of the Aragats Space Environmental Center (ASEC)
* Member of [[American Geophysical Union]] (AGU)
* Member of the international advisory committee of the European Cosmic Ray symposiums
* Member of the commission on cosmic rays of the Russian Academy of science
* Founder and spokesperson for the Space Environmental Viewing and Analysis Network (SEVAN)
* Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] (APS)<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.reporter.am/go/article/2011-12-06-armenia-scientist-recognized-by-american-physics-society- |title=Armenia scientist recognized by American Physics Society |publisher=The Armenian Reporter |quote=Prof. Ashot Chilingarian, the director of Yerevan Physics Institute and the head of its Cosmic Ray Division has been elected American Physical Society (APS) Fellow, a prestigious honor given to only a few of the world's greatest scientists. |date=2011-12-06 |access-date=2013-10-29 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120114122010/http://www.reporter.am/go/article/2011-12-06-armenia-scientist-recognized-by-american-physics-society- |archive-date=2012-01-14 }}</ref>
* Associate editor of Space Weather & Space Climate (SWSC) journal
